# ankra_cluster_variable (Resource)

A cluster-scoped variable, referenced from the cluster's stack manifests and add-on values as `${{ ankra.<name> }}`. It shadows an organisation variable of the same name and is shadowed by a stack variable. The counterpart of `ankra cluster variables set` and `ankra cluster variables delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_variable" "ingress_domain" {
  cluster_id  = ankra_cluster.production.id
  name        = "ingress_domain"
  value       = "apps.example.com"
  description = "Base domain for ingress hostnames on this cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `name` (String) Variable name. Changing it replaces the variable.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. Cluster variables have no secret mode: the platform stores and returns the value in plain text, so keep secrets in a secret organisation variable instead. Marked sensitive so plans do not print it.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the variable.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cluster variables are imported by <cluster_id>/<name>.
terraform import ankra_cluster_variable.ingress_domain 6f1c2a40-0000-4000-8000-000000000001/ingress_domain
```
